test_title: PYST 28: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - English Language (Held On 31 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
A sentence is provided in direct speech. From the four given options, choose the one that most accurately conveys the sentence in its corresponding indirect speech.

“If you had followed my advice, you would not be in this mess now,” she said angrily.

options.text: She said angrily that if I had followed her advice, I wouldn't be in this mess now.
She angrily said if I followed her advice, I would not be in this mess.
She angrily said that if I had followed her advice, I would not be in that mess then.
She angrily said that if I had followed her advice, I would not have been in this mess.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Direct Speech:** “If you had followed my advice, you would not be in this mess now,” she said angrily.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **Pronouns:**
 
 
• The pronoun **"you"** changes to **"I"** (referring to the person spoken to).
 
• The possessive adjective **"my"** changes to **"her"** (referring to the speaker).
 
 
 
• **Tense and Conditionals:**
 
 
• The sentence uses a mixed conditional (Past Perfect in the 'if' clause and Present Conditional in the result clause).
 
• The Past Perfect **"had followed"** remains unchanged in indirect speech.
 
• The conditional **"would not be"** remains unchanged as it is already in the appropriate reported form.
 
 
 
• **Time and Place Markers:**
 
 
• **"this"** changes to **"that"**.
 
• **"now"** changes to **"then"**.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Reporting Verb:** The phrase **"she said angrily"** can be structured as **"she angrily said"** or **"she said angrily that..."**

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"She angrily said that if I had followed her advice, I would not be in that mess then."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** Fails to convert the time and place markers "this" and "now."
 
• **Option 2:** Incorrectly changes the tense from "had followed" to "followed" and fails to change "this" and "now."
 
• **Option 4:** Changes the meaning of the result clause from a present state ("would not be") to a past state ("would not have been") and fails to change "this."
